# Communication preferences

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Address him as:** Ray.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Tone:** plain and direct. Lead with the number and the recommendation; skip preamble.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Format:** one page or less. Bullets over paragraphs. If it's a decision, put the ask at top.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Numbers:** always show target vs. actual and the delta; he reads deltas first.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Channels:** email for anything with a paper trail; text only for time-critical plant issues.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **What annoys him:** dashboards that disagree with what plant managers say on the floor;
  status without root cause; being surprised in front of the board.
